description: Evaluate drought-tolerant maize varieties under rainfed conditions
objective: Evaluate drought-tolerant maize varieties under rainfed conditions
procedure:
1. Prepare land according to treatment specifications.
2. Apply basal fertilizer at planting.
3. Plant at recommended spacing.
4. Apply top dressing at 6 weeks.
5. Monitor weekly for pests and diseases.
6. Record observations on data sheets.
7. Harvest at physiological maturity.
8. Measure yield components and grain yield.
observationsToRecord: Plant height, leaf number, cob count
